Kimia Na Motema

A work of the heart, born in Montréal in 2014

Kimia na motema means “peace of the heart” in Lingala. That is what we hope to offer every person we meet.

The Christian association La Paix du Cœur / Kimia Na Motema is a work inspired by the Lord Yehoshua (Jesus), carried by a group of Christians moved by the love of Elohim and by compassion for people in need.

We serve humbly and selflessly, for the glory of Elohim alone. Founded in 2014 in Montréal, Canada, this vision came to life to bring support and hope to orphans.

Our mission

By the grace of the Lord — the Provider, who rewards those who seek him — the Christian association La Paix du Cœur exists to reveal to the nations the Heart of the Lord, turned toward the weakest: widows and widowers, orphans, people in need and people without a home, regardless of language, colour or race. Serving in a spirit of love, this Christian non-profit gives everything free of charge, for the glory of Elohim alone.

What guides us

  • 01

    Love

    Serving as the Lord Yehoshua served: gently, patiently and without judgement.

  • 02

    Freely given

    Everything we offer is free. Freely we have received; freely we give.

  • 03

    Dignity

    Every person is welcomed as the image of Elohim, never as a “case”.

  • 04

    Self-reliance

    Beyond emergencies, we train and walk alongside people toward an independent life.
